title: 第十七章周边势力第十八章挑起事端
content_zh:
第十七章周边势力
在感觉到狂信徒的强大好处后，陈林就想着要多弄几个狂信徒！可是在不断的尝试以后，发现要想让这些普通的手下成为自己的狂信徒，并不是一朝一夕的事！必须让他们感觉到自己无所不能，并能给他们好处才会慢慢的成为狂信徒！
陈林思考后，发现让这些低级智慧的手下成为狂信徒的唯一方法就是战斗，带领它们不断的战斗！给它们一个自己是战无不胜的感觉，在通过魂力给他们提升实力，就会给它们一种自己无所不能的感觉！
于是陈林就开始决定要扩张自己的势力，开始攻击周围的亡灵！“灵魔，你给我说说周围都是那些势力，他们的实力如何……”
在亡灵拥有智慧之后，都会选择组建自己的势力！所以在这些高级的亡灵区域，都是有势力划分的！而且它们也会像人类一样给自己弄一个大本营什么的，虽然没有城池但至少会有一个营地！毕竟这些亡灵前世大多都是人类或是高智慧生物！
在灵魔周围的势力分别是：左边七阶中级的巫妖――哈莱姆！他的领地很大是灵魔领地的十几倍还多，手下更有好几千亡灵生物，而且还有堕落战士、木乃伊、地狱犬等这样实力超强的亡灵。
而且哈莱姆行事比较阴险，经常利用一些小计谋算计偷袭别的亡灵，而且是有仇必报的主！手下的实力都是很了得，他本身也是个实力很强的高级巫妖，
而在陈林领地右边是七阶高级的僵尸王――莫哥，手下全部是清一色的僵尸！手下的人数也不多只有**百，领地只有灵魔的两倍！不过莫哥却是个狠角色很难对付，手下只是七阶以上的就有五个，而且莫哥的队伍相当团结！莫哥自身的实力也因为自身变异，已经拥有和七阶巅峰叫板的实力！只是这个莫哥不愿意争地盘，只是收缩在一片山岭区域！
而在莫哥领地的后面，是亡灵界赫赫有名的亡灵生物――亡灵骑士！这个死亡骑士叫索尔！是一名八级初级的亡灵骑士。手下高级的亡灵好几十个，而且手下有一支由亡灵骑士组成的队伍，十分强大在索尔的带领下所向无敌，在周围根本没有对手！要不是因为莫哥在中间当着，而且有天然的地形屏障，灵魔早就被索尔剿灭了！
而在灵魔领地更向里的高级区域则是有两个势力！分别是七阶巅峰的亡灵法师――杰斯利。
这个杰斯利是灵魔能接触到的最强大亡灵，只差一步就能到八阶！而且他的手下高级亡灵很多，而且实力都很强！要不是因为某些原因！杰斯利早就将灵魔和哈莱姆剿灭，统一这一片区域了！
另一个势力是亡灵界本土的生物地狱犬！地狱犬这种生物也是亡灵的一种，是亡灵界存在之初就有的一种生物。它们既有超高的攻击，还会很多不同的黑暗魔法，而且速度奇快防御力也是很强！单个的实力在同阶只能算是中等偏上！而且地狱犬是群居的生物，经常成群的外出猎杀其它的亡灵，它们并不用进食而是通过击杀亡灵得到黑暗能量生存！
其实这些地狱犬并不能算是一个势力，它们只是生活在这个区域，经常在一片区域活动猎杀其它亡灵！
正因为地狱犬的存在，让本来想要统一这片区域的杰斯利不能实现，因为一直被地狱犬骚扰牵制而！而且哈莱姆这个七阶中级巫妖也经常利用地狱犬来偷袭他，使得杰斯利不能按下心来剿灭地狱犬！这片区域有了一个微妙的平衡！灵魔用自己的智慧在这些高级亡灵区域占据了一小片区域！虽然经常被周围的势力围剿，随时会被剿灭但是都让灵魔躲了过去一直到现在！
在灵魔被陈林收服并提升到了高级亡灵后，灵魔就开始疯狂的崇拜陈林，觉得陈林无所不能！听说陈林好攻击周围的势力灵魔很高兴，因为灵魔自己以前经常会被周围的势力围剿！现在自己已经晋级高级亡灵，而且还有无所不能的主人，灵魔感觉自己报仇的时候到了！
陈林在听灵魔介绍完周围的势力以后，就开始思考起啦！没想到灵魔在这个区域只是在夹缝中生存着，随时都会被消灭！现在虽然已经晋级高级了，不过和周围的势力比起来还是没法比！陈林相信灵魔之所以能存活到现在，是因为实力根本没被周围的势力看在眼里！
要是灵魔一早就拥有高级亡灵的实力，周围的势力早就将灵魔收服了！周围的几个势力是绝对不会，让一个可以威胁到它们的势力存在的！
陈林在考虑过后，发现自己现在的实力根本没有法和周围的势力相比！所以只有挑起它们之间的战争，这样自己才能在它们中间坐收渔翁之力！不过这个渔翁可不是那么好当的，必须出其不意让它们没有警惕才行！
在决定好后，陈林开始计划起来，莫哥虽然是它们之间势力最小的一个，却也是最难对付的！所以也就不在陈林计划之内！反正它们还帮助抵挡这八阶的亡灵骑士！这样陈林也能放心的统一这一区域的亡灵！免得自己刚收服就被别的亡灵坐收渔翁之力！
僵尸莫哥排除后，就只剩下地狱犬族群、七阶中级巫妖哈莱姆还有七阶巅峰的亡灵法师杰斯利！这三个势力中地狱犬只是个族群并不好控制，那么就只有让巫妖哈莱姆和亡灵法师杰斯利两个打起来了！因为哈莱姆的势力比较小，那么只要让杰斯利的势力有所损失，以哈莱姆的性格肯定会趁火打劫的！

在决定好了之后，陈林就命令灵魔和小黑各自带领这队伍，前往杰斯利的势力范围骚扰攻击！陈林择自己前去地狱犬的区域看看能不能将地狱犬族群也牵扯进来！就这样陈林开始了他势力发展的第一步！
陈林看着小黑它们出发，自己在心里突然涌起无限的战意“周围的这些势力，早晚都会被我拿下，在亡灵界将会只有一个君王，那就是我陈林！”

Chapter 17 Surrounding Forces
After feeling the powerful benefits of fanatic believers, Chen Lin wanted to get more fanatic believers! However, after constant attempts, I discovered that it does not happen overnight to make these ordinary subordinates become my fanatical followers! You must make them feel that they are omnipotent and can benefit them before they slowly become fanatical believers!
After thinking about it, Chen Lin found that the only way to turn these low-level intelligent subordinates into fanatical believers was to fight and lead them to fight continuously! Give them a feeling that they are invincible, and increase their strength through soul power, and you will give them a feeling that they are omnipotent!
So Chen Lin decided to expand his power and began to attack the surrounding undead! "Spirit Demon, tell me about the forces around you and what their strength is..."
After the undead gain wisdom, they will choose to form their own forces! Therefore, in these high-level undead areas, there are divisions of forces! And they will also build themselves a base camp or something like humans. Although there is no city, there will at least be a camp! After all, most of these undead were humans or highly intelligent creatures in their previous lives!
The forces surrounding the spirit demon are: the seventh-level intermediate lich on the left - Harlem! His territory is more than ten times larger than the spirit demon territory, and he has thousands of undead creatures under his command, as well as fallen warriors, mummies, hellhounds and other super powerful undead.
Moreover, Harlem acts in a rather insidious manner, often using some small schemes to plan sneak attacks on other undead, and he is a master who must avenge his enemies! The strength of his subordinates are all very impressive, and he himself is also a very powerful high-level lich.
On the right side of Chen Lin's territory is the seventh-level advanced zombie king-Brother Mo, whose subordinates are all zombies! The number of his subordinates is only a few hundred, and his territory is only twice that of the spirit demons! However, Brother Mo is a ruthless character who is difficult to deal with. He has five subordinates who are only level seven or above, and Brother Mo's team is quite united! Brother Mo's own strength is also due to his own mutation, and he already has the strength to compete with the seventh-level peak! It's just that Brother Mo doesn't want to fight for territory and just shrinks to a mountainous area!
And behind Mogo's territory is the famous undead creature in the undead world-the undead knight! This death knight is called Thor! He is an eighth-level junior undead knight. There are dozens of high-level undead under his command, and he has a team of undead knights. They are very powerful and invincible under the leadership of Thor. There is no opponent at all around them! If it weren't for Brother Mo standing in the middle and the natural terrain barrier, the spirit demon would have been wiped out by Thor long ago!
And in the high-level area further inside the spirit demon territory, there are two forces! They are the seventh-level peak necromancer-Jesli.
This Jessel is the most powerful undead that the spirit demon can come into contact with, and is only one step away from reaching the eighth level! Moreover, he has many high-level undead men, and they are all very powerful! If not for some reason! Jesly has long since wiped out the Spirit Demon and Harlem and unified this area!
Another force is the Cerberus, a creature native to the undead world! Creatures like Cerberus are also a type of undead, a creature that existed from the beginning of the undead world. They not only have super high attacks, but also can use many different dark magics. They are also incredibly fast and have very strong defense! The individual strength can only be considered above average at the same level! Moreover, Cerberus are social creatures and often go out in groups to hunt other undead. They do not need to eat but obtain dark energy to survive by killing undead!
In fact, these hellhounds are not considered a force. They just live in this area and often move around the area to hunt other undead!
It is precisely because of the existence of Cerberus that Jesly, who originally wanted to unify this area, cannot realize it because he has been harassed and restrained by Cerberus! And Harlem, a seventh-level cityThe super lich also often uses hellhounds to sneak attack on him, making Jesly unable to press his heart to destroy the hellhounds! This area has a delicate balance! The spirit demons used their own wisdom to occupy a small area in these high-level undead areas! Although he is often surrounded by surrounding forces and could be wiped out at any time, the spirit demon has been able to hide away until now!
After the spirit demon was subdued by Chen Lin and promoted to a high-level undead, the spirit demon began to worship Chen Lin crazily and felt that Chen Lin was omnipotent! I am very happy to hear that Chen Lin is good at attacking the surrounding forces, because the spirit demon himself was often surrounded and suppressed by the surrounding forces in the past! Now that he has been promoted to a high-level undead and has an omnipotent master, the spirit demon feels that the time has come for him to take revenge!
After listening to the spirit demon introduce the surrounding forces, Chen Lin started to think! Unexpectedly, the spirit demons in this area only exist in the cracks and will be eliminated at any time! Although he has advanced to a high level now, he is still incomparable to the surrounding forces! Chen Lin believes that the reason why the spirit demon can survive until now is because its strength is not noticed by the surrounding forces at all!
If the spirit demon had possessed the strength of a high-level undead, the surrounding forces would have subdued the spirit demon long ago! The surrounding forces will never allow a force that can threaten them to exist!
After thinking about it, Chen Lin found that his current strength could not compare with the surrounding forces! So the only way is to provoke a war between them, so that you can be a fisherman among them! But this fisherman is not that easy to be a fisherman. He must catch them by surprise so that they are not alert!
After making the decision, Chen Lin began to plan. Although Brother Mo was the least powerful among them, he was also the most difficult to deal with! So it’s not part of Chen Lin’s plan! Anyway, they helped to resist the eighth-level undead knight! In this way, Chen Lin can safely unify the undead in this area! Lest he be taken advantage of by other undead souls as soon as he conquers them!
After Zombie Mogo is eliminated, only the Cerberus clan, the seventh-level intermediate lich Harlem, and the seventh-level peak necromancer Jesly are left! Among these three forces, Cerberus is just a group and is not easy to control, so the only choice is to let the Lich Harlem and the Necromancer Jesly fight! Because Harlem's power is relatively small, as long as Jesly's power is reduced, Harlem's character will definitely take advantage of it!
After making the decision, Chen Lin ordered Ling Mo and Xiao Hei to lead their respective teams to harass and attack Jesli's area of ​​influence! Chen Lin chose to go to the Cerberus area himself to see if he could involve the Cerberus group! In this way, Chen Lin took the first step in the development of his power!
Chen Lin watched Xiao Hei and the others set off, and an infinite fighting spirit suddenly surged in his heart. "Sooner or later, these forces around me will be taken down by me. There will be only one king in the world of the undead, and that is me, Chen Lin!"
